svg.title: Initial Core v0 deployment with one control-plane Server and multiple Vault locations
svg.desc: Engineer Windows computers run a browser, WPF WebView2 Desktop, per-user Workspace and external engineering tools. One Ubuntu Server virtual machine runs Nginx, Temurin, Spring Boot and PostgreSQL. Large file bytes bypass this Server and move through a selected Artifact Gateway to one of multiple Vault locations. Vault-to-Vault replication is policy governed. A separate backup target protects database, Artifact, configuration, policy and key recovery sets. Multiple Vaults do not make the Server highly available.
